title: Quantitative Analyticity for Lyapunov Exponents of Random Products of Matrices with Explicit Polydiscs and Cauchy Coefficient Bounds
summary: The top Lyapunov exponent $λ_+(A, p)$ of a random product of matrices in $\mathrm{GL}(d, \mathbb{R})$, $d \geq 2$, with simple top spectrum, depends real-analytically on the probability weights $p$ and the matrix coefficients $A$.
